results.title: FlutterFlow Alternative | RapidNative vs FlutterFlow Comparison | RapidNative
results.content:
What about FlutterFlow's Dreamflow?

FlutterFlow launched Dreamflow as their AI-powered dev environment. It's a solid addition to their platform. The key difference: Dreamflow enhances visual building with AI assistance, while RapidNative is AI-first from the ground up — prompts are the primary interface, not an add-on.

Which framework is better: Flutter or React Native?

Both are excellent choices with large communities. Flutter (used by FlutterFlow) compiles to native code and has great performance. React Native (used by RapidNative) offers a massive ecosystem, TypeScript support, and is used by companies like Meta, Microsoft, and Shopify. Choose based on your team's expertise and preferences.

What is the cost? [...] Do I own the source code?

Absolutely. You own 100% of your code. Download the full package at any time. It's standard, clean TypeScript code that any React Native developer can understand and extend.

How is this different from FlutterFlow?

FlutterFlow is a Visual IDE — you build by dragging, dropping, and configuring elements visually. They've added AI features recently with Dreamflow, but the core experience is still visual assembly. RapidNative is AI-first — you describe the result you want, and we generate the implementation. It's a fundamentally different approach to building apps.

What about FlutterFlow's Dreamflow? [...] # FlutterFlowis “Visual IDE” RapidNative is “AI Architect”

FlutterFlow pioneered visual app building with drag-and-drop tools and recently added AI features with Dreamflow. But at its core, you're still assembling apps element-by-element. RapidNative takes a different approach: describe what you want in plain English, and our AI writes production-ready React Native code for you.
